categories.name: Testing Lab
categories.description: This category contains curated prompts, logic frameworks, and system-generated analyses related to candlestick pattern recognition and interpretation within the NEA Trading Journal Analysis Engine.  It focuses on identifying and validating single, two-candle, and multi-candle formations such as pin bars, engulfing patterns, inside bars, hammers, marubozu structures, and advanced composite signals. Each prompt reflects institutional-grade interpretation of price action, emphasizing context, structure, and confirmation rather than isolated pattern signals.  Entries in this section are designed to integrate with multi-timeframe analysis, volume confirmation, and broader market structure frameworks (Wyckoff, momentum regimes, and trend state classification). The goal is to translate raw OHLC movement into actionable behavioral insights that reflect liquidity shifts, accumulation/distribution phases, and potential reversal or continuation conditions.  Use this category as the primary reference layer for all candlestick-based signal generation, validation logic, and trade entry/exit refinement within the system.
